exercises.ten_viet: Chùng chân lùi luân phiên với đòn
exercises.steps: Stand tall with the barbell resting on your upper back and hands holding it firmly. | Step one foot back and lower your back knee towards the floor with control. | Keep your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes. | Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
exercises.setup: Set the bar on a rack at chest height and unrack it with both feet under the bar. | Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, wrists straight, elbows pointing down. | Leave enough space behind you to step back safely; use the rack safety pins. | Start with an empty bar until the movement feels steady.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Set the rope attachment at about face height and hold one end in each hand. | Step back until your arms are straight and stand tall with a steady torso. | Pull the rope towards your face, keeping your elbows high and apart. | Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning back.
exercises.setup: Set the cable pulley at face height and use the rope attachment. | Hold the rope with thumbs pointing back towards you. | Pull the rope ends apart beside your ears; keep your ribs down. | Choose a light weight: you should control the return without being pulled forward.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand beside a low, stable bench with a clear landing area. | Bend your knees slightly and swing your arms to prepare. | Hop over the bench and land softly on bent knees. | Reset your balance before the next hop. Choose a non-jumping alternative if needed.
exercises.setup: Only use a very stable, low step or bench that cannot slide; clear the floor around you. | Wear shoes with grip; skip this exercise on a slippery floor.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.
exercises.review_note: Động tác bật qua ghế: cần HLV duyệt chiều cao bục, mặt sàn và cách tiếp đất trước khi quay.

exercises.ten_viet: Nhón gót đứng bằng trọng lượng cơ thể
exercises.steps: Stand tall near a wall or rail for balance, feet hip-width apart. | Rise onto the balls of your feet by lifting your heels. | Pause for a moment at the top. | Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
exercises.setup: Hold a wall, chair back or door frame lightly for balance. | Stand on the edge of a stair for a bigger range once the floor version feels easy.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.ten_viet: Dead bug – duỗi tay/chân đối bên
exercises.steps: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and hips and knees bent at ninety degrees. | Gently press your lower back towards the floor and breathe out. | Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg forward. | Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
exercises.setup: Use a mat or carpet so your back is comfortable. | Move slowly; if your lower back lifts off the floor, reduce how far you reach.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.ten_viet: Đẩy ngực với tạ đơn trên ghế
exercises.steps: Lie on a flat, stable bench with feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand at chest level. | Press the dumbbells up above your chest without locking your elbows. | Lower the dumbbells slowly back to the sides of your chest. | Keep your shoulders and back supported on the bench throughout.
exercises.setup: You need a stable, flat bench and dumbbells; do not use a sofa or soft surface. | Without a bench, do a floor press: lie on a mat and press from the floor.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.ten_viet: Kéo tạ đơn khi gập hông
exercises.steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips with a slight knee bend. | Keep your back steady and let your arms hang below your shoulders. | Pull the dumbbells towards your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging.
exercises.setup: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; keep a slight bend in your knees. | Rest one hand on a chair seat if you want extra back support (one-arm version).
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.ten_viet: Cuốn tay trước với tạ đơn
exercises.steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells with your arms straight and palms facing forward. | Keep your elbows close to your sides. | Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders without swinging your body. | Lower them slowly back to the start.
exercises.setup: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; stand with your back against a wall to stop swinging.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. | Take a controlled step forward into a comfortable split stance. | Bend both knees and lower your body, keeping your front heel on the floor. | Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
exercises.setup: Clear a space about two steps long in front of you. | Hold a wall or chair for balance if needed.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms by your sides. | Tighten your stomach and glutes. | Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, without arching your lower back. | Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
exercises.setup: Use a mat on the floor; place your heels about a hand's length from your hips.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands slightly wider than your shoulders. | Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor. | Press back up to the start. Use a knee or wall push-up if you need an easier version.
exercises.setup: Place hands flat on the floor, fingers spread, directly under or slightly wider than your shoulders. | Use a mat for comfort; start with knee or wall push-ups if needed.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand tall in a clear space with your feet together. | Step forward into a lunge, bending both knees with control. | Push through your front foot and bring your back foot forward to stand. | Continue forward, alternating legs at a steady pace.
exercises.setup: You need a clear hallway or room length; walk in a straight line.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out. | Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting into a chair. | Lower within a comfortable range, keeping your chest up and heels down. | Push through your feet to stand tall again.
exercises.setup: Place a chair behind you as a target and safety: lightly touch it and stand up. | Keep your weight across your whole foot, not only the toes.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Set the bar in a rack with safety supports at a suitable height. | Rest the bar on your upper back, brace your torso and step back carefully. | Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat to a controlled depth. | Drive through your feet to stand up without rounding your back.
exercises.setup: Set the bar in the rack at mid-chest height and the safety pins just below your lowest squat depth. | Grip the bar evenly, hands just outside your shoulders, wrists straight; rest it on your upper back, not your neck. | Step back only two or three small steps and set your feet shoulder-width apart. | Ask for a spotter or use safety pins; start with the empty bar.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders. | Step your feet back and rest on your toes. | Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels and tighten your stomach. | Breathe normally and hold for the planned time.
exercises.setup: Use a mat or carpet under your forearms. | Look at the floor between your hands to keep your neck long.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Lie on your side with your elbow directly under your shoulder. | Stack your feet or place the top foot in front for balance. | Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line. | Hold while breathing, then change sides.
exercises.setup: Use a mat; bend your knees for an easier version.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. | Keep your back flat and your hips level. | Slowly extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back. | Return to the start and switch sides.
exercises.setup: Use a mat; place a cushion under your knees if needed.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand facing a stable wall and place your palms on it at chest height. | Step your feet back a little so your body leans forward in a straight line. | Bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the wall. | Press back to the start with control.
exercises.setup: Place hands on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing up. | The further your feet are from the wall, the harder it becomes.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Start on your hands and knees, then walk your hands forward until your body is straight from knees to shoulders. | Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders. | Bend your elbows to lower your chest between your hands. | Press back up without letting your hips sag.
exercises.setup: Put a folded towel or mat under your knees. | Hands a little wider than shoulders, fingers forward.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Sit or stand tall holding a dumbbell beside each shoulder. | Tighten your stomach to keep your back steady. | Press the dumbbells overhead within a comfortable range. | Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.
exercises.setup: Use light dumbbells or water bottles; sit on a sturdy chair with back support if standing is hard.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides and a soft bend in your elbows. | Raise your arms out to the sides up to about shoulder height. | Pause briefly at the top without shrugging. | Lower slowly without swinging.
exercises.setup: Use very light dumbbells or water bottles; lighter is better here.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Anchor the band securely at chest height and check it is safe. | Hold the ends and step back until the band is slightly tight. | Pull your elbows back close to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades. | Return slowly to the start.
exercises.setup: Anchor the band in a closed door with a door anchor or around a sturdy post. | Check the band for cracks before every session.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips. | Soften your knees slightly. | Push your hips back while keeping your back straight, letting your torso lean forward. | Bring your hips forward to stand tall without leaning back.
exercises.setup: Hold a broomstick along your back touching head, upper back and tailbone to learn a straight back.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand facing a low, stable step. | Place your whole foot on the step. | Step up with control and bring your other foot up. | Step down slowly one foot at a time, then change the leading leg.
exercises.setup: Use the bottom stair or a very stable, low step; hold the handrail.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand tall with relaxed shoulders. | Lift one knee gently, then the other, marching in place. | Swing your arms naturally and breathe easily. | Keep the pace comfortable; this is a warm-up.
exercises.setup: Any clear space works; march on a carpet or mat to reduce impact.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it for support. | Step one foot back and keep that leg straight. | Gently press the back heel towards the floor until you feel a stretch in the calf. | Hold without bouncing, then switch sides.
exercises.setup: Use a wall or door frame for support.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand or sit comfortably with relaxed shoulders. | Breathe in slowly through your nose. | Breathe out slowly and fully. | Continue calmly until your breathing returns to normal.
exercises.setup: Sit or stand anywhere quiet.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair or bench with feet flat. | Lift one knee a little while keeping your back upright. | Lower it with control. | Alternate legs at a steady pace without leaning back.
exercises.setup: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand with your back against a stable wall and feet about a step away from it. | Slide down until your knees are comfortably bent. | Keep your back against the wall and breathe normally. | Hold, then slide back up to stand. Stop if it becomes uncomfortable.
exercises.setup: Use a smooth wall; place a mat under your feet so they do not slide.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

exercises.steps: Stand tall next to a stable support. | Lift your heels slightly so you balance on the balls of your feet. | Hold the position steadily without gripping your toes. | Lower your heels slowly when the time is up.
exercises.setup: Stand next to a wall, counter or chair back.
exercises.mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.
exercises.review_note: ID cũ ghi heel-walk nhưng nhãn hiện tại là heel raise. Chốt rõ nhón gót hay đi bằng gót với HLV trước khi quay.

exercises.steps: Sit at the machine and adjust the thigh pads so your legs are held firmly. | Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders with palms facing forward. | Lean back slightly, then pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back. | Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight, keeping control.
exercises.setup: Adjust the thigh pad so you cannot lift off the seat. | Use a grip just wider than shoulders; thumbs around the bar. | Pull to the top of your chest, never behind the neck. | Pick a weight you can pull without swinging your body.
exercises.mistakes: Leaning far back and swinging the body. | Pulling the bar behind the neck.

exercises.steps: Sit on the bench with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent. | Hold the handle with arms straight and back tall. | Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
exercises.setup: Use the V-handle with palms facing each other. | Keep your chest up; do not lean back more than a little. | Pull elbows close to your sides toward your hips.
exercises.mistakes: Rounding the back to reach forward. | Jerking the weight with the body.

exercises.steps: Set the cable high and hold the bar or rope with elbows close to your sides. | Stand tall with a slight forward lean and stomach tight. | Push down until your arms are straight, moving only your forearms. | Let your hands rise slowly to about chest height.
exercises.setup: Pin your elbows to your sides; only the forearms move. | With a rope, spread the ends apart at the bottom. | Choose a weight you can control without leaning over it.
exercises.mistakes: Letting elbows move forward and back. | Leaning over the weight.

exercises.steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with your back on the pad. | Hold the handles with a slight bend in your elbows. | Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging motion. | Open your arms slowly until you feel a light stretch in the chest.
exercises.setup: Set the seat so your elbows are level with your shoulders. | Keep shoulders down and back against the pad. | Stop opening when you feel a gentle stretch, not pain in the shoulder.
exercises.mistakes: Letting the arms go too far back. | Shrugging the shoulders.

exercises.steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest. | Sit with your back flat on the pad and feet on the floor. | Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight. | Bring the handles back slowly to chest level.
exercises.setup: Set the seat so handles are at mid-chest, not at the neck. | Grip with wrists straight and elbows slightly below shoulder height. | Breathe out as you press, in as you return.
exercises.mistakes: Locking the elbows hard. | Lifting the back off the pad.

exercises.steps: Sit with your back flat on the pad and place your feet hip-width apart in the middle of the platform. | Release the safety handles and hold the side grips. | Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly, keeping your lower back on the pad. | Press the platform away through your whole foot without locking your knees.
exercises.setup: Feet flat, hip-width, in the middle of the platform. | Lower only as far as your lower back stays on the pad. | Lock the safety handles before getting out.
exercises.mistakes: Letting the lower back round off the seat at the bottom. | Locking the knees at the top.

exercises.steps: Adjust the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point. | Place the lower pad on the front of your shins, just above the ankles. | Straighten your legs to lift the pad and pause briefly. | Lower slowly back to the start.
exercises.setup: Line up your knee with the red pivot dot on the machine. | Hold the side handles to keep your hips on the seat. | Use a light weight and move slowly; stop if the knee hurts.
exercises.mistakes: Kicking the weight up fast. | Lifting the hips off the seat.

exercises.ten_viet: Cuốn đùi sau máy tư thế ngồi
exercises.steps: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot and lower the thigh pad onto your thighs. | Place the lower pad behind your legs, just above your heels. | Curl your heels down and under the seat while keeping your back on the pad. | Let your legs return slowly until they are almost straight.
exercises.setup: Line up your knees with the pivot point of the machine. | Lower the thigh pad until it holds your legs firmly. | Hold the handles and move slowly in both directions.
exercises.mistakes: Letting the weight pull your legs up quickly. | Lifting the hips or leaning back to move the weight.
exercises.review_note: ID cũ ghi lying nhưng tên bài hiện tại là Seated leg curl. Quay tư thế NGỒI; bài tư thế NẰM có ID gym-lying-leg-curl-machine riêng.

exercises.equipment: Đòn và bánh tạ, Ghế/bục chắc chắn
exercises.steps: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor. | Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack with straight arms. | Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body. | Press the bar back up over your shoulders and rack it safely.
exercises.setup: Set safety arms just below chest height or ask for a spotter. | Squeeze shoulder blades together and keep feet flat. | Wrists straight over elbows; start with the empty bar.
exercises.mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest. | Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

exercises.steps: Stand with feet hip-width and the bar over the middle of your feet. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs. | Brace your stomach, keep your back flat and stand up by pushing the floor away, bar close to your legs. | Lower the bar by pushing your hips back, keeping it close, until it touches the floor.
exercises.setup: Learn the hip hinge first; start with a light bar or plates on blocks. | Keep the bar touching your legs the whole time. | Never round your back to reach the bar.
exercises.mistakes: Rounding the back. | Letting the bar drift away from the legs.

exercises.steps: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs with hands shoulder-width apart. | Soften your knees and keep your back straight. | Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs until you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs. | Squeeze your glutes and bring your hips forward to stand tall.
exercises.setup: Start from standing (take the bar from a rack). | Keep the bar close to your legs. | Go down only as far as your back stays flat.
exercises.mistakes: Bending the knees too much like a squat. | Rounding the back to go lower.

exercises.steps: Hold the bar with hands just wider than shoulders and stand tall. | Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back and soft knees. | Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades. | Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.setup: Grip just wider than shoulders, palms facing you. | Keep your torso still; only the arms move. | Use a light weight first to learn the position.
exercises.mistakes: Standing up during each rep. | Rounding the lower back.

exercises.steps: Set both pulleys high and hold one handle in each hand. | Step forward with one foot for balance, leaning slightly forward. | With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest. | Return slowly until you feel a light stretch in the chest.
exercises.setup: Stand in the middle of the station with a split stance. | Keep the elbow bend the same throughout. | Use a light weight; the movement should feel smooth.
exercises.mistakes: Bending the elbows into a press. | Using too much weight and losing balance.

exercises.steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. | Place your hands lightly beside your head or across your chest. | Breathe out and lift your shoulders off the floor using your stomach muscles. | Lower slowly back down.
exercises.setup: Use a mat; keep your chin slightly tucked and do not pull on your neck.
exercises.mistakes: Pulling on the neck with the hands. | Sitting all the way up quickly.

exercises.steps: Lie face down with arms stretched forward and legs straight. | Look at the floor to keep your neck long. | Gently lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor. | Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
exercises.setup: Use a mat; lift only a small height without pain.
exercises.mistakes: Lifting too high and straining the lower back. | Holding the breath.

exercises.steps: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing your body. | Keep your elbows close to your sides. | Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping palms facing in. | Lower slowly to the start.
exercises.setup: Use dumbbells or filled water bottles; stand against a wall to stop swinging.
exercises.mistakes: Swinging the body. | Letting elbows move forward.

exercises.steps: Sit on the edge of a stable bench or chair and place your hands beside your hips. | Slide your hips off the edge with knees bent and feet flat. | Bend your elbows to lower your body a little, elbows pointing back. | Press up until your arms are straight.
exercises.setup: Use a sturdy chair against a wall so it cannot slide; keep knees bent for an easier version.
exercises.mistakes: Going too low and straining the shoulders. | Elbows flaring out.

exercises.steps: Set the leg pads wide enough to feel a gentle stretch, then sit with your back against the pad. | Place the inside of your knees against the pads and hold the handles. | Squeeze your legs together in a smooth arc until the pads nearly touch. | Open your legs slowly back to the start without letting the weights touch.
exercises.setup: Start with a small range; widen it only if your hips feel comfortable. | Keep your back against the pad the whole time.
exercises.mistakes: Letting the weight slam the legs open. | Leaning forward and rocking the body.

exercises.steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your shoulders. | Sit with your back flat on the pad and grip the handles. | Press the handles straight up until your arms are almost straight. | Lower slowly back to shoulder level and repeat.
exercises.setup: Keep your feet flat and your ribs down so your back stays on the pad. | Stop just before your elbows lock.
exercises.mistakes: Arching the lower back away from the pad. | Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

exercises.ten_viet: Kéo xà bằng máy trợ lực
exercises.steps: Choose an assistance weight; a heavier setting gives more help. | Step onto the platform, grip the handles slightly wider than your shoulders and kneel on the pad. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down. | Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight, then repeat.
exercises.setup: Start with plenty of assistance and reduce it over the weeks. | Keep your shoulders away from your ears as you pull.
exercises.mistakes: Swinging or kicking to get up. | Dropping down too fast.

exercises.ten_viet: Cuốn đùi sau máy tư thế nằm
exercises.steps: Lie face down with your knees just past the edge of the bench and the pad just above your heels. | Hold the handles and press your hips into the bench. | Curl your heels toward your hips as far as is comfortable. | Lower the pad slowly until your legs are almost straight.
exercises.setup: Keep your hips down on the bench. | Use a weight you can lower slowly.
exercises.mistakes: Lifting the hips off the bench. | Letting the weight drop on the way down.

exercises.steps: Set the safety stops just below your lowest squat position. | Step under the bar, rest it on your upper back and place your feet slightly in front of you, shoulder-width apart. | Twist the bar to unhook it, then bend your knees and hips to sit down slowly. | Push through your whole foot to stand up, then twist the bar back onto the hooks when finished.
exercises.setup: Always set the safety stops first. | Go only as low as you can keep your back straight.
exercises.mistakes: Feet too far back so the knees hurt. | Forgetting to set the safety stops.

exercises.steps: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads, feet shoulder-width apart. | Release the safety handles. | Bend your knees and lower slowly while keeping your heels down. | Press back up through your whole foot and lock the safety handles when done.
exercises.setup: Start light; this machine is harder than the leg press. | Keep your knees in line with your toes.
exercises.mistakes: Heels lifting off the platform. | Bouncing at the bottom.

exercises.ten_viet: Nhón gót máy tư thế ngồi
exercises.steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pads resting on your lower thighs. | Release the safety lever. | Raise your heels as high as you can and pause briefly. | Lower your heels slowly below the platform for a gentle stretch, then repeat.
exercises.setup: Move slowly and pause at the top. | Push through the big toe side of your foot.
exercises.mistakes: Bouncing quickly through short reps. | Rolling onto the outside of the feet.

exercises.steps: Attach a straight bar or handle to the low pulley and stand facing the machine. | Hold the bar with palms up, arms straight and elbows close to your sides. | Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows. | Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
exercises.setup: Stand tall and keep your elbows still. | Use a weight you can control on the way down.
exercises.mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight. | Elbows drifting forward.

exercises.ten_viet: Đẩy ngực tạ đơn trên ghế dốc
exercises.steps: Set the bench to a low incline and sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh. | Lie back and bring the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, palms facing forward. | Press the dumbbells up until your arms are almost straight above your chest. | Lower them slowly back to the sides of your chest.
exercises.setup: At home, do incline push-ups with hands on a sturdy table.
exercises.mistakes: Bench set too steep, turning it into a shoulder press. | Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

exercises.steps: Place one knee and one hand on a bench with your back flat. | Hold a dumbbell with your upper arm close to your side and your elbow bent. | Straighten your elbow to move the dumbbell back until your arm is straight. | Bend your elbow slowly to return, then switch arms after the set.
exercises.setup: At home, use a water bottle or a band.
exercises.mistakes: Swinging the upper arm. | Rounding the back.

exercises.ten_viet: Duỗi tay sau với tạ qua đầu
exercises.steps: Sit or stand tall and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head. | Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head. | Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head. | Straighten your arms to lift it back up.
exercises.setup: At home, use a water bottle or a light dumbbell.
exercises.mistakes: Elbows flaring wide. | Arching the lower back.

exercises.ten_viet: Hip thrust – nâng hông tựa ghế
exercises.equipment: Đòn và bánh tạ, Ghế/bục chắc chắn
exercises.steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips. | Place your feet flat, about hip-width apart, so your shins are vertical at the top. | Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees. | Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.
exercises.setup: Use a bar pad for comfort. | Keep your chin tucked and ribs down at the top.
exercises.mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top. | Feet too close or too far.

exercises.steps: Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders with palms facing away. | Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down. | Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.setup: Use the assisted machine first if you cannot do 5 good reps. | Keep your body still; no swinging.
exercises.mistakes: Kicking or swinging. | Doing half reps without lowering fully.

exercises.ten_viet: Nâng tạ vai sau khi gập hông
exercises.steps: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back. | Let your arms hang below your shoulders with a slight bend in the elbows. | Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders. | Lower slowly and repeat.
exercises.setup: At home, use water bottles or a band.
exercises.mistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging. | Rounding the back.

exercises.steps: Stand tall holding the bar with palms facing up, hands shoulder-width apart. | Keep your elbows close to your sides. | Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows. | Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercises.setup: An EZ bar is easier on the wrists. | Keep your body still; no swinging.
exercises.mistakes: Leaning back to swing the bar. | Letting the bar drop quickly.
